records.name: public.workspace_chat_admin_capabilities_pkey
records.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspace_chat_admin_capabilities_pkey ON public.workspace_chat_admin_capabilities USING btree (workspace_id)

records.name: chat_admin_capability_owner_read
records.using:
(chat_admin_multi_character AND (granted_to_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.workspaces w
  WHERE ((w.id = workspace_chat_admin_capabilities.workspace_id) AND (w.owner_user_id = auth.uid())))))

records.name: chat_admin_conversations_owner_all
records.check:
((fan_id IS NOT NULL) AND public.is_current_chat_admin_workspace(workspace_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.chat_character_fans f
  WHERE ((f.workspace_id = chat_character_conversations.workspace_id) AND (f.character_id = chat_character_conversations.character_id) AND (f.id = chat_character_conversations.fan_id)))))

records.name: chat_admin_messages_owner_all
records.check:
((fan_id IS NOT NULL) AND public.is_current_chat_admin_workspace(workspace_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.chat_character_conversations c
  WHERE ((c.workspace_id = chat_character_messages.workspace_id) AND (c.character_id = chat_character_messages.character_id) AND (c.fan_id = chat_character_messages.fan_id) AND (c.id = chat_character_messages.conversation_id)))))
